notes.title: Patch 1.25 ■ Custom driver names
notes.content:
Driver names can now be customized. It is very simple.

[b]1.[/b] Access [b][GAMEFOLDER]\Super Woden GP 2_Data\StreamingAssets[/b]
[b]2.[/b]Rename the file[b] "_pilot_names.txt"[/b] to [b]"pilot_names.txt"[/b]. Simply remove the "_" character.
[b]3.[/b]Edit the file with notepad or any simple text editing program.
[b]4.I[/b]t is [b]very important[/b] to respect the structure of the lines of text. The last field is the the Drivers nationality (flag). This is the official 2-letter code of each country. For reference: [url=www.iban.com/country-codes] link [/url]

Also 
■ Loading times have been improved.
■ Added additional confirmation on loading screens where gameplay tips appear

notes.title: Custom skins Update
notes.content:
Patch 1.23. Custom skins Update

It is now possible to create jpg files with custom paints for some vehicles.

Instructions:

1. Access to GAME FOLDER/Super Woden GP 2_Data\StreamingAssets\CAR_SKINS, then open the desired brand and model folder. In Photoshop, Paint_dot_net, or any program of your choice, create a 1024x1024 image (preferably).
2. You can add the bounds or base layers to have a reference on how to paint the new skin, these files are included for each car in the respective folder.
3. Save the skin as a jpg (preferably) or png file.
4. The file name must be the skin number. For example, it would be 1.jpg for the first skin, 2.jpg for the second, etc.
5. You can check the results almost in real time, saving the file and changing the skin, for example on the dealer screen.
6 .If you want to go back to the original skin, just delete the file.

Notes:
At the moment it is not possible to add a greater number of skins than the ones the car originally has. They can only be replaced.

I will work so that possibly in the future they can also be modified and add more skins than the ones that the car originally comes with.

Feel free to share your creations!
